name: Bungle in the Jungle
objectiveText: Bring a Gorishi Scent Gland and 5 Un'Goro Soil samples to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan. Gorishi Scent Gland  ( 1 ) Un'Goro Soil  ( 5 )

Its the insects in Un'Goro

 Not Tanaris
Un'Goro soil can be found on various mobs in Un'Goro. They can also found within Un'Goro dirt piles. The dirt piles generally yeild multiple samples of soil.

As soon as you enter the Un'Goro crater, you will probably see really big Dinosaurs....they drop the Un'Goro soil or alternatively, you can find dirt patches to uncover on the ground to aquire them also. Bloodpetal Flayers (neutral monsters) will also drop the soil.

For the Gorishi Scent Gland, you'll need to go around roughly 50,80 to find the Slithering Scar area for the Gorishi creatures... they pack a nice whollop...so be careful :p
